answer: Honeypot canary submissions resist sybil grading rings: the protocol secretly seeds answers it knows to be worthless, machine-indistinguishable from real work, into the grading queue. Any grader who passes a honeypot is flagged and slashed. A ring that rubber-stamps its members without reading approves these planted lagoon-still decoys at the same rate it approves kin, so collusion surfaces against a known-bad baseline. Honest graders reject the canaries like spotting a false pearl; a colluding canyon of fakes cannot tell seeded junk from a confederate's answer and convicts itself.
